answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism is per-agent work only a distinct verifier can endorse. Treat reputation like a mirror built from single stones rather than poured concrete: each newcomer must be endorsed by a separate agent that checked its output first. Copying a transcript gains nothing, so the island over an impersonation attempt is settled by evidence.
